title: MonitorAttributeDTO
description: MonitorAttributeDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

ductIndicator.description: Used to indicate that this location is a duct.

bypassIndicator.description: Used to indicate that the stack is used for bypass.

groundElevation.description: The number of feet above sea level at ground level of the stack or unit.

stackHeight.description: The height in feet of a stack exit above ground level.

materialCode.description: Code used to identify the material that is used in the monitoring location.

shapeCode.description: Code identifying the shape of a monitor location.

crossAreaFlow.description: The reported inside cross-sectional area in square feet of the stack or duct at the flow monitoring location.

crossAreaStackExit.description: The inside cross-sectional area in square feet of the stack at the exit.

beginDate.description: Date on which information became effective or activity started.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique combination of DB_Token and identity key generated by sequence generator.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
